periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the visible eye patches is oriented diagonally, descending laterally from the medial superior position toward the cheeks.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio significantly greater than 1.0.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering is visible, with the geometric center located in the upper half of the patch's vertical span.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is broad, covering the entire shoulder and upper humerus region, approximately 35% of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation between pinnae, with a distance approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly curved, semicircular apex with high circularity and no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Proninent rufous/brownish discoloration or soil-based staining present on the ventral abdominal fur.
